$comment: SDD factory runtime configuration for this repository. Policy for the orchestrator, not rules for the code: rules live in docs/constitution.md. Later replaced by the control plane.

approvals.$comment: Human approval gates the orchestrator may grant on its own when the artifact is verifiably clean: Intake, Spec, Design, Task, Final. A Constitution issue is never merged without a human.

reviewers.$comment: Intelligence tier of the Review Gate agents by issue type (wins) or triage size; tiers: light | standard | strong.

intelligence.$comment: Intelligence tier per phase: a tier (light | standard | strong) or a map by triage size {S, M, L, default}. Tiers describe the work, not a vendor model; the worker maps tiers to models in its own config. Errors in spec and design are the most expensive to detect, so they get the strongest tier.
